title: Jacob's Blessing of Ephraim and Manasseh
description: The aging Jacob blesses Joseph's two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh. He crosses his hands so that the younger Ephraim receives the greater blessing, to Joseph's surprise, and adopts them as his own sons.
